name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Valve's competitive FPS. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); very large download (~35 GB).

variables.label: LD_LIBRARY_PATH (Linux)
variables.description: Exported to the server process so the CS2 runtime libraries are found. Leave as-is.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Enables console commands via Source RCON (on the game port) when set. Leave empty to disable RCON.

notes: Public/community-listed servers require a Game Server Login Token (GSLT) for app 730 from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers — add +sv_setsteamaccount <token> to the start command. Windows hosts: set the start command override to game\bin\win64\cs2.exe with the same arguments. Server config lives in game/csgo/cfg/.
